findings.description: Sleeps even on the last retry attempt, contrary to specification that requires no sleep after the final failed call.
findings.evidence: For operation that raises TransientError on all attempts, e.g. candidate.call_with_retry(flaky(3), 3, sleeps.append, 1), the candidate sleeps three times ([1, 2, 4]) whereas the specification requires only two sleeps ([1, 2]) before re‑raising the last TransientError on the final attempt.

review.summary: Candidate implementation violates retry delay contract by sleeping after the final failed attempt.
